items.title: Side roadmap Item 4: Card Studio and `/avatarcard`
items.notes: Built on branch claude/pf-020 (4a hardening, 4b no pre-approval preview, 4c male/female kits + migration 0064, 4d queue position/ETA + hourly submit throttle, 4e /avatarcard panel on pf:card: ids, 4f before/after shots 390/820/1440 in the notes folder). LEFT FOR THE OWNER (Item 4d, not decided here): (1) Workers Paid plan: same model and quality, lifts the 10,000 neurons/day free pool shared by every AI feature, costs money. (2) Composite cinematic from the portrait cutout: halves AI calls, cinematic looks less natural. (3) Fallback image provider: member face photos leave Cloudflare, privacy and consent risk. (4) How far to widen the one-request-per-month limit: needs a table rebuild (UNIQUE(user_id, month), migration 0039) and raises AI use. Also owner-side: 1-minute cron and a higher per-run limit change AI spend. Deploy notes: new migration 0064_card_kit_variant; Worker deploy for the panel, kit variants and the new /avatarcard command shape (re-register commands); upload male and female kit reference images in Staff Artwork. Staff kit example image not made (text do/don't guide only). PAUSED 2026-11-15 at 85% by owner order ("next"): everything that does not depend on Item 4d is merged; the 4d owner questions (Workers Paid plan or fallback image provider, monthly limit) are in PLANNING/NEXT-SESSION-PROMPT history and the PF-020 report. Resume when the owner answers. DONE 2026-11-16: owner said 'just do it' on 4d. Stayed on the free Workers AI pool (no paid plan, no fallback provider, so no photos leave Cloudflare). Monthly limit is now wrangler var CARD_MONTHLY_LIMIT (set to 2; code default 1; 1 to 10), stored as month slots ('2026-11#2') so no table rebuild; site and /avatarcard footer read it; test in tests/cardstudio.test.mjs. Cron spend settings unchanged. Owner-side deploy: apply migration 0064, deploy Worker, re-register commands, upload kit reference images.

doneLog.what: Item 4d closed with the free Workers AI pool: monthly card limit is the wrangler var CARD_MONTHLY_LIMIT (2; code default 1, range 1 to 10), stored as month slots (2026-11#2) so no table rebuild; mine() returns limit and used; site Card Studio and the /avatarcard footer read it; tests/cardstudio.test.mjs covers it. No paid plan, no fallback provider, cron spend unchanged.
